subjects.description: The ServiceAccounts this binding grants to. A subject is what a workload's Pod runs as, so an agent this cluster does not host is an ordinary subject. Every Pod running as the account is this subject and nothing ends the subject with a workload, so bind only an account dedicated to one; the app gives each sandbox an account of its own, owned by it.

policies.description: EgressPolicy names in the binding's namespace.

expiresAt.description: After this instant the binding contributes nothing.
